# Numbering changelog

**Generated by `scripts/build_numbering_changelog.R` — do not edit.** Every row is computed from
the committed `docs/data/alignment_meta.parquet` and `docs/data/alignment_columns.parquet`, so this
file cannot fall behind the artifacts it describes.

A **column index is a fact about a VERSION of the registry** (`CLAUDE.md` §8, "Registry
versioning"): the alignment, the prune threshold and the numbering are one versioned object. If you
have stored `aln_column` values, every row below is a point at which they may have become wrong.
`family_position` is derived from the alignment too and moves with it.

**`moved` is the number that matters.** A new `aln_version` is necessary but not sufficient for a
coordinate to move — admitting a member re-runs the MSA and changes the hash even where every
existing index survives. `moved` counts `(uniprot_id, protein_position)` pairs that landed in a
DIFFERENT `aln_column` than in the previous version. `-` means the comparison was not available
(the family is new, or that commit predates the shipped columns table).

Assert against `alignment_meta.input_sha256` to detect staleness; see
[tables/SCHEMA.md](../../tables/SCHEMA.md) § Detecting stale positions.
